serverFindings.finding: rpc_list_my_agreements_page ACTIVE excludes all COMPLETED; rpc_home_attention supplies exact eligible-rating counts separately, but can fail independently. Completed disputes are not part of the current Home attention projection; its own_agreements CTE includes CONFIRMED/AWAITING_REQUESTER only.

Grouped active includes CONFIRMED/AWAITING_REQUESTER OR rating_due and all members of each selected active task group. counts.hasAny includes history-only accounts. A first page is insufficient for all Home facts; group count is not the count of bilateral agreements.

The group cursor uses mutable attention rank and accepted start. viewAt fixes relative-day ordering, not row versions or status. An automatic full walk cannot be claimed snapshot-consistent when a group changes before the cursor. This is source reasoning, not a concurrent SQL benchmark.

rpc_get_worker_calendar(from,to) returns only caller-owned worker BLOCKING events overlapping the range. It cannot replace requester agreements, completed exact-window events, or loose/start-only agreements.

smallestSafeFutureScope.home: A purpose-specific bounded aggregate/read contract for accepted next appointments, exact counts and hasAny, eligible reviews, and a complete or explicitly paginated prompt list. Alternatively a scoped reader with stable traversal can be evaluated, but not first-page substitution. Preserve account/abort guards and failed-read unknown state.
smallestSafeFutureScope.calendar: An authorized range reader for both participant roles using accepted current Agreement terms (including completed overlaps and start-only instants), plus separate complete counts/paging for active agreements without a placeable term. Keep existing worker calendar conflict authority; include version and range/cursor binding. Filtering created_at cannot replace accepted-time overlap.
smallestSafeFutureScope.currentDecision: Do not replace either consumer in this package. Existing ports alone do not provide a small complete bounded replacement; coordinate a new server read contract before changing UI reads.
